title: Session Note Export Backlog
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=therapy:homework
| search event_type="session_note_export"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by provider_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which providerss have gone quiet for session note exports.
value: An export backlog means useful context is staying trapped in one tool instead of feeding your review habit.
implementation: Send session note exports events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of providerss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which providerss have gone quiet longer than they should for session note exports.
